name: Robotics Task
about: Define a specific task, build job, or unit of work for the team
title: '[TASK] '
labels: task, triage
assignees: ''
---

## 📋 Task Description
A clear and concise description of the task to be completed.
*(e.g., Design and manufacture the intake rollers for the new gamepiece, or Write an auto-routine for the 3-piece center taxi.)*

## 🤖 Subsystem / Category
Which area of the robot or team does this task fall under? (Check all that apply)

- [ ] Drivetrain / Controls
- [ ] Manipulator / Mechanism (Intake, Shooter, Climber, etc.)
- [ ] Vision / Localization
- [ ] Autonomous / Path Planning
- [ ] Electrical / Wiring
- [ ] Mechanical / CAD / Manufacturing
- [ ] Scouting / Strategy
- [ ] Dashboard / UI
- [ ] Other: __________

## 🎯 Context & Motivation
Why is this task important? What goal or strategy does it support?
*(e.g., Our current intake struggles with the new gamepiece geometry. A compliant roller design will allow us to intake faster and reduce jamming.)*

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria (Definition of Done)
What specific conditions must be met for this task to be considered complete?
*(e.g., 1. CAD is reviewed and approved. 2. Parts are cut and assembled. 3. Intake successfully picks up the gamepiece 5 times in a row without jamming.)*
- [ ] Criteria 1
- [ ] Criteria 2
- [ ] Criteria 3

## 📝 Action Items / Breakdown
Break this task down into smaller, actionable steps.
- [ ] Step 1: ...
- [ ] Step 2: ...
- [ ] Step 3: ...

## 🔗 Dependencies & Blockers
Is this task waiting on something else, or is it blocking another task?
- **Blocked by:** [e.g., Waiting on motor controller shipment / Requires chassis frame to be welded first (Issue #12)]
- **Blocks:** [e.g., Cannot start wiring the pneumatics until this bracket is mounted (Issue #15)]

## 🚦 Priority & Timeline
- **Priority:** [e.g., 🔴 Critical / 🟡 High / 🟢 Medium / ⚪ Low]
- **Target Completion Date:** [e.g., End of Week 2 / Before upcoming practice match]

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, links to CAD files, strategy documents, or references here.
